text: The Patriots put together what might be their most impressive performance of the season in a dominant 45-17 rout of the Raiders on Sunday, with Drake Maye accounting for five total touchdowns and delivering what film review indicates was his best performance to date—a particularly impressive feat given that he was operating without his top receiver and the team was missing both starting cornerbacks. Maye's deep ball appears to have returned to form, a crucial development after his shaky start to the season, and he managed to orchestrate this offensive explosion despite the mounting injury toll that claimed RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and LT Will Campbell (knee sprain) during the contest. The victory proved that this Patriots offense can execute at a high level even when rotating in backups and working around personnel losses, a resilience that Coach Mike Vrabel will surely emphasize as New England tries to navigate the health concerns heading forward. All of this came while the team made the fashion statement of the week, donning throwback uniforms in what was one of several notable uniform reveals across the league.
